case.title: Migrate PostgreSQL to DynamoDB
case.proposal: Migrate primary relational order storage from PostgreSQL to DynamoDB.

prosecution.summary: Relational query patterns and dual-write consistency risks are under-addressed.

arguments.claim: Ad-hoc reporting joins will require secondary pipelines once normalized tables are removed.

defence.summary: Single-table key access eliminates connection-pool exhaustion at peak traffic.

arguments.claim: 95% of hot-path reads look up orders by primary key.

evidence.title: Order Service Query Inventory
evidence.content: Analytics exports execute 4 multi-table joins nightly.

constraints.description: Zero-downtime cutover required during business hours.

assumptions.statement: Peak write throughput will not exceed 10,000 WCU during Q4.

context.detail: Core backend team has 3 years of PostgreSQL experience and limited DynamoDB experience.
